tests.name: native_word_empty_datastore_preserves_body_and_round_trips
assertions: Exact paragraph text and count; empty data-store presence survives snapshot and canonical publication.
tests.scope_limit: Plain paragraph and empty metadata only; other producer metadata remains uncovered.

tests.name: native_word_write_reservation_keeps_exact_hash_and_five_paragraphs
assertions: Five native paragraph markers; exact 120-byte write-reservation SHA-256; absent legacy reservation; snapshot and model-writer preservation.
tests.scope_limit: Passive hash retention only; no authentication or document protection execution.

tests.name: native_word_run_edit_preserves_empty_datastore_and_source_snapshot
assertions: One body run replacement survives save/reopen with empty metadata and original source bytes intact.
tests.scope_limit: Single run replacement only; other transaction operations remain uncovered.

tests.name: native_word_datastore_documents_retain_markers_through_model_writer
assertions: Native body markers and full parsed body text survive canonical model writing; data-store presence and table/field counts retained.
tests.scope_limit: Counts do not establish semantic completeness of fields, pictures, objects, protection or embedded fonts.

tests.name: native_word_bidi_and_east_asian_text_retains_unicode_scalars
assertions: Exact Arabic, Hebrew, Japanese and Chinese text before and after canonical writing.
tests.scope_limit: Unicode text only; shaping, direction and East Asian layout properties remain uncovered.

tests.name: native_word_structural_opaque_tables_preserve_source_and_refuse_canonical_loss
assertions: Native table and body markers; empty data store retained on snapshot publication; canonical writer returns InvalidInput before writing any bytes for structural opaque owners.
tests.scope_limit: Explicit canonical-writer boundary from the current feature matrix; supported source-splice edits are tested separately.

tests.name: native_word_table_grid_exposes_all_four_cell_values
assertions: Exact 2x2 Table Grid cell values: Key, Value, RTF_CELL_006 and 42 before and after snapshot publication.
tests.scope_limit: Basic table read only; nested, merged and floating tables remain uncovered.

tests.name: native_word_table_cell_edit_preserves_every_unrelated_source_byte
assertions: Changing one table cell produces exactly the source bytes with its text replaced; neighbor cell and data store retained; source snapshot unchanged.
tests.scope_limit: Single table-cell text operation; no general opaque-owner edit claim.

tests.name: native_word_review_retains_insert_delete_and_comment_content
assertions: Two typed insertion/deletion revisions with expected native text; both native comment/reply texts survive canonical publication.
tests.scope_limit: Content and revision type only; authors, ranges, threading, accept/reject and review mutations remain uncovered.
